findings.obs_text: In 1Ki 18:27 cry (H7121I) stands five words before musing, in Elijah's taunt: they are to cry out because their god may be musing and not hearing.
findings.grounds: Cry aloud, for he is a god

older.finding: the mocker mocked: Sennacherib, who mocked the Lord, is scorned in turn (2Ki 19:21)
older.reason: it states how mocking turns on the mocker; the scoff collection owns it

findings.obs_text: In Psa 119:48 and Psa 119:97 love (H0157G) stands before the meditation, one to three words ahead, with one object: the commandments or the law that is loved is what is meditated on.
findings.grounds: Oh how I love your law! It is my meditation

findings.obs_text: In Psa 145:5 glorious, splendor and majesty (H3519, H1926, H1935) open the verse, three to five words before meditate, and name the first object of the meditation: the splendor of God's majesty.
findings.grounds: On the glorious splendor of your majesty

findings.obs_text: In Psa 77:12 mighty deeds (H5949) stands directly after meditate as its object: the deeds of God are what the speaker meditates on.
In Psa 38:12 hurt (H7451C) stands three words before meditate, naming what the ones who meditate treachery seek: the speaker's harm.
In Psa 119:23 plotting (H1696G) stands two words before meditate, in the clause set against it: princes speak against the speaker, and he meditates on the statutes.
In Pro 15:28 answer (H6030B) stands directly after ponders as its object: the righteous heart ponders how to answer.
In Psa 119:148 promise (H0565A) stands two words after meditate as its object, and the waking eyes before the night watches are for this meditation.
findings.grounds: that I may meditate on your promise

findings.obs_text: In Psa 119:78 falsehood (H8267) stands two words before meditate, naming how the insolent wronged the speaker; his meditating is set against it.
In Psa 143:5 old (H6924H) stands directly before meditate, in the clause before it: the days of old are what is remembered, and the meditating on God's deeds follows.
findings.grounds: I remember the days of old

older.finding: old as the former time that remembering, considering or comfort is directed at
older.reason: it states the use of the word old; the refresh collection owns it

findings.obs_text: In Psa 19:14 acceptable (H7522) stands three words after meditation and says what the speaker asks for the meditation of his heart, with the words of his mouth: that they be accepted.
In Jos 1:8 prosperous (H6743B) stands ten words after meditate, in the outcome of the doing the meditation serves: the way made prosperous.
In Pro 15:28 righteous (H6662) stands directly before ponders and names whose heart ponders.
findings.grounds: The heart of the righteous ponders

findings.obs_text: In 1Ki 18:27 aloud (H1419A, with H6963A at the same place) stands four words before musing and qualifies the crying Elijah calls for, not the musing.
findings.grounds: Cry aloud, for he is a god

findings.obs_text: In 1Ki 18:27 mocked (H2048A) stands seven words before musing and gives the frame of the verse: the musing of the god is named in mockery.

older.finding: mocking and scorn said of God, who holds the nations in derision (Psa 2:4)
older.reason: it states how mocking is said of God; the scoff collection owns it
